info.sub_ename: THE WORLD OF CLASSICAL PIANO LITERATURE

description.sub_ename: THE WORLD OF CLASSICAL PIANO LITERATURE
description.describe_ch: 本課程以輕鬆淺顯的方式，帶領學生們認識古典鋼琴音樂中的經典作品，透過了解鍵盤樂器的演變發展、作曲家的小故事、以及不同時代的美學和藝術觀，讓學生們了解鋼琴音樂不同時期的風格特色及轉變，學生們透過音樂的聆賞，能加強其美感經驗與人文素養，並以此提高主動學習及探索新曲目的熱情。
description.describe_eh: The course guides the students to experience the beauty of classical piano literature and its stages of transformation. Through discussions of the history and development of keyboard instrument, biographies and cultural backgrounds of the featured composers, the students will make connections between knowledge and real-life aesthetic experiences, thus developing a capability to further explore and enjoy classical music in the future.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用課堂所學，透過音樂欣賞提高生活品質
targets.describe_en: Improve the quality of life by applying music appreciation skills learned in the course

targets.describe_ch: 透過了解古典鋼琴音樂之各樂派風格，培養對此藝術的想像力
targets.describe_en: Understand various styles of classical piano literature and to foster imagination

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Please follow the proper school procedures in advance if you need to miss a class.

◆ You are required to take notes during weekly lectures.
◆ Written notes will be collected during a randomly selected week for grading.
◆ Loose-leaf paper or a binder is recommended.

Each group will present a selected repertoire from a specific stylistic period. The presentation should include a brief biography of the composer, the historical and cultural background, the inspiration for the composition, and the musical features of the work, along with personal reflections on the piece.

Twice a Semester.
Students will identify stylistic periods, composers, and genres of selected compositions.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. Attendance 出席狀況 (15% )

2. Written notes 課堂筆記 (10% 作業部份)

3. Listening Quiz (multiple choices) – Twice a semester 聽聽看小考兩次 (期中10% + 期末10% = 20%)
Identify stylistic periods, composers, and genres of selected compositions.
以分組報告之曲目以及課堂中聽過的曲目為範圍，鑑賞和辨別作曲家、樂派及風格。 

4. Group Presentation 分組報告 (30%):
Each group will present a selected repertoire from a specific stylistic period. The presentation should cover a short biography of the composer, the background, inspiration, and musical features of the composition, along with personal thoughts on the musical work itself.
每組以老師指定的曲目範圍內，搜集資料、研究整理，並以口頭報告和Power Point的呈現方式介紹給班上同學 (30 %): 

5. Concert Reflection Paper 音樂會心得報告 (25%): 
選擇一場鋼琴音樂會，出席欣賞，並於期末繳交一份音樂會心得報告，並附上節目單 (若選擇網路上的音樂會，節目內容需至少一小時以上)。
Three -page reflection paper summarizes your thoughts on a live solo piano concert of your choice, which helps you to make the connection between knowledge learned in class and real-life experience. (If an online concert program is selected, it needs to be at least an hour long. URL link to the online concert should be sent to the instructor in advance for approval)
